question: The Brahmaputra marks the ______ boundary of the Himalayas.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Eastern-most**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Brahmaputra river marks the easternmost boundary of the Himalayas.
 
• This originates from Mansarovar Lake, which is also a source of the Indus and Sutlej.
 
• It is 3848kms long, a little longer than the Indus River.
 
• It flows parallel to the Himalayas in the eastward direction.
 
• When it reaches Namcha Barwa, it takes a U-turn around it and enters India in the state of Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• Here it is known as the Dihang River. 
 
• This river is called the Yarlung Tsangpo in Tibet.
 
• It is the ninth largest river in the world by discharge.
